Hi Sanjay / Ava —

Thanks again for taking the time today. - Tue Mar 7 — 09:30–11:00

I attached a short runbook outline and a pre-read that covers our typical deployment patterns. If those two slots don't work, send a few alternatives and we will lock something down.
